content.text: Perfect! Now I understand the structure. Let me query for the data we need - acts performed for beneficiaries aged 80 and over (AGE_BEN_SNDS = 80), where the prescriber (PRE_INS_REG) is in Ile-de-France (11), in claims processed in March 2025 (FLX_ANN_MOI = 202503):

input.sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(PRS_ACT_QTE) as total_acts
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS
WHERE AGE_BEN_SNDS = 80  -- 80 ANS ET +
  AND PRE_INS_REG = 11   -- Ile-de-France
  AND FLX_ANN_MOI = 202503 -- March 2025
